- 企业微信：corp_weixin
- 飞书：feishu
description.en:
The bound mobile type.

- DingTalk: ding
- WeCom: corp_weixin
- Lark: feishu

description.zh:
绑定移动端用户ID

- 钉钉：钉钉账号的unionId
- 企业微信：企微账号的userId
- 飞书：飞书账号的userId
><notice>mobileUserId需要开发者自行调用钉钉、企微、飞书的相关接口获取。></notice>
description.en:
The bound mobile user ID.

- DingTalk: The unionId of the DingTalk account.
- WeCom: The userId of the WeCom account.
- Lark: The userId of the Lark account.
><notice>The mobileUserId must be obtained by calling the relevant API operations of DingTalk, WeCom, or Lark.></notice>

title.en: Query userId by bound third-party account ID
